mentions.mention: partial or complete loss of γ-amino butyric acid uptake
mentions.sentence: Based on functional assays of solute carrier Family 6 Member 1 variants, we conclude that partial or complete loss of γ-amino butyric acid uptake due to reduced membrane γ-amino butyric acid transporter 1 trafficking is the primary aetiology.

mentions.mention: forward trafficking of the wildtype γ-amino butyric acid transporter 1
